mapper.select: SELECT * FROM presale_report_export WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM presale_report_export WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM presale_report_export WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE presale_report_export SET status = 'RUNNING', worker_id = #{workerId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM presale_report_export WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < #{deadline} ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE presale_report_export SET status = 'FAILED', error_msg = 'WORKER_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT', render_token_id = NULL, cancel_requested = 0, metrics_json = #{metricsJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE presale_report_version SET export_success_count = COALESCE(export_success_count, 0) + 1, export_success_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{versionId}
UPDATE presale_report_export SET idempotency_key = #{archivedKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SUCCESS'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM presale_report_export WHERE expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at < #{now} AND file_purged_at IS NULL AND status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE presale_report_export SET file_purged_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND file_purged_at IS NULL
